description: Suijin OS v5.5.0 — harness competence. Six evidence-backed loop repairs from real field traces: the engagement state board (working memory finally populated and rendered every turn), job semantics (finished background jobs drain into the conversation, waits never self-background, status untruncated), dispatch-layer anti-repeat (identical failing calls blocked at three with alternatives), the undormant control plane (51 skills reachable, plan queue fixed, prompt-hygiene CI gates), claim-time finding verification with honest verdicts plus repaired engagement memory, and per-iteration audit telemetry. 1,648 tests green.
